question: Approve to terminal, ratifying the disclosed surface overrun past declared tolerance?

artifacts.summary: The grammar replaces the hardcoded four-rounds-by-two-events chain with round parsing, a one-repeat budget, branch-keyed routing and round-level reviewer independence; every red names its violated invariant instead of a bare count. Validation reproduced all six ACs independently — re-measuring the AC-1 baseline against the pre-change grader and re-grading both AC-6 lanes from retained digest bytes — and ran a seven-mutation battery showing every clause load-bearing. It partially refuted the worker's own overrun account: net code alone is +163, past the declared +155 ceiling, so the overrun is real growth rather than a comment artifact. No condition forcing a return to ideation is present. Recommend PASSED with captain ratification of the tolerance deviation.
